nodes.description: Gamestop.owner: privileged address (0x10B16eEDe03cF73CbF44e4BFFFa3e6BFf36F1Fad) checked by the onlyOwner modifier and recipient of token 0 in the constructor.
Gamestop.ipfsLocation: metadata URI returned by tokenURI and mutable only by setIPFSLocation.
Gamestop.launchDate: hardcoded launch timestamp (1626261600) mutable only by setLaunchDate.
ERC721._owners: mapping(uint256 => address) from token id to owner, written by _mint, _burn and _transfer.
ERC721._balances: mapping(address => uint256) token count per holder, mutated arithmetically by _mint, _burn and _transfer.
ERC721._tokenApprovals: mapping(uint256 => address) per-token approval, written by _approve and read by getApproved/_isApprovedOrOwner.
ERC721._operatorApprovals: nested mapping of operator approvals set by setApprovalForAll and read by isApprovedForAll.
Gamestop constructor: payable ERC721('Gamestop','GME'), mints token 0 to owner and emits Mint.
Gamestop.tokenURI(uint256): requires _tokenId == 0 and returns the ipfsLocation string.
Gamestop.setIPFSLocation(string): privileged state-mutating entry point guarded by onlyOwner.
Gamestop.setLaunchDate(uint): privileged state-mutating entry point guarded by onlyOwner.
Gamestop.onlyOwner modifier: require(owner == msg.sender) authorization gate for admin functions.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and operator identity.
Address.sendValue: low-level recipient.call{value: amount}('') forwarding all gas to an arbitrary address.
Address.functionCallWithValue: low-level target.call{value: value}(data) to an arbitrary target with arbitrary calldata.
Address.functionStaticCall: low-level target.staticcall(data) to an arbitrary target.
Address.functionDelegateCall: low-level target.delegatecall(data) executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received external callback: control is handed to a receiver-controlled contract during safe transfers/mints.
ERC721._mint arithmetic: _balances[to] += 1 (Solidity ^0.8.0 built-in overflow checking).
ERC721._burn/_transfer arithmetic: _balances[owner] -= 1 and _balances[from] -= 1 (Solidity ^0.8.0 built-in underflow checking).
ERC721.transferFrom(address,address,uint256): external entry point that authorized callers use to move tokens.
ERC721.safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256[,bytes]): external entry point performing a transfer plus receiver callback.
ERC721.approve(address,uint256): external entry point that grants per-token approval.
ERC721.setApprovalForAll(address,bool): external entry point granting operator-wide approval keyed by msg.sender.
ERC721._isApprovedOrOwner(address,uint256): authorization helper combining owner, token approval and operator approval checks.
ERC721._safeTransfer: internal transfer followed by the onERC721Received receiver check.
ERC721._mint(address,uint256): internal mint updating _balances and _owners.
ERC721._burn(uint256): internal burn clearing approvals, decrementing _balances and deleting the owner entry.
ERC721._transfer(address,address,uint256): internal ownership/balance bookkeeping for token moves.
ERC721._approve(address,uint256): internal write to _tokenApprovals plus Approval event.
ERC721._checkOnERC721Received: external call into the receiving contract and validation of the returned selector.
Context._msgSender(): returns msg.sender and is the only inbound propagation path for caller identity.
Address.sendValue(address payable,uint256): balance check then low-level value call.
Address.functionCallWithValue: contract check then arbitrary low-level call with value and calldata.
Address.functionStaticCall: contract check then arbitrary static call.
Address.functionDelegateCall: contract check then arbitrary delegate call.
Parameter _ipfsLocation of Gamestop.setIPFSLocation(string).
Parameter _launchDate of Gamestop.setLaunchDate(uint).
Parameter _tokenId of Gamestop.tokenURI(uint256).
Parameter from (previous owner) of ERC721._transfer/_safeTransfer.
Parameter to (recipient) of ERC721._transfer/_safeTransfer, also the callback target.
Parameter tokenId of ERC721._transfer/_safeTransfer.
Parameter operator of ERC721.setApprovalForAll(address,bool).
Parameter approved (bool) of ERC721.setApprovalForAll.
Parameter to (approved account) of ERC721.approve(address,uint256).
Parameter tokenId of ERC721.approve(address,uint256).
Parameter recipient (address payable) of Address.sendValue.
Parameter amount (uint256) of Address.sendValue.
Parameter target (address) of Address.functionCall* helpers.
Parameter data (bytes) of Address.functionCall* helpers.
Parameter value (uint256) of Address.functionCallWithValue.
Local variable owner assigned from ERC721.ownerOf(tokenId) inside approve/_burn/_isApprovedOrOwner for authorization comparisons.
Local variable success capturing the boolean result of the low-level value call in Address.sendValue.
Local variable retval capturing the bytes4 selector returned by the onERC721Received callback.

edges.reason: onlyOwner requires owner == msg.sender, so caller-controlled msg.sender directly decides whether the privileged branch executes.
The onlyOwner modifier reads the owner state variable as the authorization reference for admin functions.
setIPFSLocation is gated by onlyOwner; only the stored owner address can reach the state write.
setLaunchDate is gated by onlyOwner; only the stored owner address can reach the state write.
Caller-supplied _ipfsLocation parameter is written into the ipfsLocation state variable.
setIPFSLocation mutates the ipfsLocation state variable.
Caller-supplied _launchDate parameter is written into the launchDate state variable.
setLaunchDate mutates the launchDate state variable.
tokenURI constrains the caller-supplied token id with require(_tokenId == 0).
tokenURI reads and returns the ipfsLocation state variable.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender, propagating untrusted caller identity into ERC721 internals.
transferFrom authorizes the caller through _isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId).
safeTransferFrom authorizes the caller through _isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId) before any transfer.
approve requires the caller to be the owner or an approved operator of the token.
setApprovalForAll writes _operatorApprovals keyed by _msgSender(), so the caller chooses its own approval namespace.
transferFrom delegates its authorization decision to _isApprovedOrOwner.
safeTransferFrom delegates its authorization decision to _isApprovedOrOwner.
transferFrom performs the ownership and balance bookkeeping through _transfer.
safeTransferFrom routes through _safeTransfer to add the receiver check.
_safeTransfer first performs the ordinary _transfer bookkeeping.
_safeTransfer invokes _checkOnERC721Received after the transfer, which can call back into an attacker-controlled receiver contract.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external onERC721Received call, handing control to the receiving address.

The receiver callback executes while ERC721 transfer context is live, giving re-entrant access to balance-mutating entry points; token state is updated before the call so checks-effects-interactions is respected.
approve performs the actual state write through _approve.
_transfer clears the previous approval by calling _approve(address(0), tokenId).
_transfer writes the new owner into _owners[tokenId].
_transfer decrements _balances[from]; Solidity ^0.8.0 enforces underflow checks.
The decrement operation mutates the _balances state variable.
_mint increments _balances[to]; Solidity ^0.8.0 enforces overflow checks.
The increment operation mutates the _balances state variable.
_mint assigns _owners[tokenId] = to.
_burn decrements _balances[owner]; Solidity ^0.8.0 enforces underflow checks.
_burn deletes the _owners[tokenId] entry.
_approve writes the approved address into _tokenApprovals[tokenId].
setApprovalForAll writes the operator flag into _operatorApprovals[_msgSender()][operator].
The constructor mints the single token through the internal _mint routine.
The constructor mints token 0 directly to the owner state variable address.
Address.sendValue performs the low-level value call represented by the unsafe operation node.
Address.functionCallWithValue performs the arbitrary low-level call with value.
Address.functionStaticCall performs the arbitrary static call.
Address.functionDelegateCall performs the arbitrary delegate call.
sendValue forwards to the caller-supplied recipient address.
sendValue forwards the caller-supplied amount as call value.
functionCall helpers target the caller-supplied target address.
functionCall helpers execute caller-supplied calldata.
functionCallWithValue forwards the caller-supplied value.
The success flag is derived from the low-level value call result.
retval is the selector returned by the untrusted onERC721Received callback.
_isApprovedOrOwner consults the per-token approval stored in _tokenApprovals.
_isApprovedOrOwner consults the operator approval stored in _operatorApprovals.
The local owner read from ownerOf(tokenId) is compared against _msgSender() to authorize approve.
_transfer validates that the from parameter equals the recorded token owner.
_transfer writes the to parameter into _owners and _balances.
_transfer indexes owner, approval and balance state with the tokenId parameter.
setApprovalForAll stores the operator parameter as the approved operator.
setApprovalForAll stores the approved boolean as the operator flag.
approve forwards the to parameter into _approve.
approve forwards the tokenId parameter into ownerOf and _approve.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _ipfsLocation only feeds the setIPFSLocation entry point and can be folded into that function node.
Parameter _launchDate only feeds the setLaunchDate entry point and can be folded into that function node.
Parameter _tokenId is only used for the require check inside Gamestop.tokenURI.
Parameter from is only consumed by ERC721._transfer for the ownership check.
Parameter to is only consumed by ERC721._transfer as the new owner and callback target.
Parameter tokenId only indexes state inside ERC721._transfer.
Parameter operator only feeds the setApprovalForAll approval write.
Parameter approved only feeds the setApprovalForAll approval flag.
Parameter to of approve is only forwarded into the _approve write.
Parameter tokenId of approve only indexes the approval state.
Parameter recipient is the address invoked by the low-level value call unsafe operation.
Parameter amount is the value attached to the low-level value call unsafe operation.
Parameter target is the address invoked by the low-level call unsafe operation.
Parameter data is the calldata executed by the low-level call unsafe operation.
Parameter value is the ether attached to the low-level call unsafe operation.
Local owner is only used for the caller-vs-owner authorization comparison in approve.
Local success is only the boolean result of the low-level value call unsafe operation.
Local retval is only the selector returned by the untrusted onERC721Received callback.
